fairways.remaining: All other mowing boundaries and fringe widths need individual contemporary tracing.

buildings.remaining: Roof outlines differ from ground footprints because of overhang, parallax and additions. Building wall outlines and heights are not established by these RGB crops. The available vegetation raster has no usable interior roof-height samples. Retain supplementary OSM footprints and explicit generic height status.

vegetation.standExclusionAction: Suppress representative placements at new playing boundaries while preserving all measured height/fraction channels and crown objects.
